# Reordering POS Categories

POS Categories control the tiles on your till's home screen and the order they appear in. The same order is used everywhere — change it once in OrderHub and every till follows.

## Reordering in OrderHub

1. Go to the **Products Catalogue** page (Dashboard → Quick Actions → Products).
2. Click **Manage POS Categories** in the page header.
3. Drag a row by its grip handle (the six-dot icon on the left) to its new position.
4. The new order saves immediately — there's no Save button.

* Note: reordering works within each level. If your categories are nested (a category inside another category), dragging reorders the categories that share the same parent. To move a category under a different parent, use **Edit** on that category instead.

* Note: if you've typed in the search box, dragging is turned off — clear the search to reorder.

## Reordering from the till

Staff can also reorder categories directly on the till:

1. Open the **Settings** screen on OHPOS.
2. Drag a category tile to its new position.

The change saves straight away and applies to OrderHub and every other till in your organisation. Every till-side reorder is recorded in the audit log.

## What the order affects

- The order of category tiles on the till home screen, left to right.
- The order categories are listed in **Manage POS Categories**.

Inactive categories stay in the list in OrderHub (so you can still manage them) but never appear on the till. Categories with no sellable products on a till's website are also hidden from that till automatically.

## Best practices

- Put your busiest categories first — staff shouldn't have to scroll for everyday products.
- Agree the order once and change it rarely, so staff build muscle memory.
- Use nesting for large catalogues: a handful of top-level categories with subcategories inside is faster to navigate than one long list.
